title: Large-Data Global Criteria for Two-Dimensional Critical-Energy Schrödinger Maps
summary: We study large-data continuation below the critical energy for the two-dimensional sphere-valued Schrödinger map \[ \partial_t u=u\timesΔu, \qquad u:[0,T_+)\times\mathbb{R}^2\to\mathbb{S}^2, \qquad E(u_0)<4π. \] Working directly with the original equation through the complex tangential fields $W_m=\partial_m u+\mathrm{i} u\times\partial_m u$ and the ambient connections $Γ_α$, we prove frequency-envelope bounds governed by the critical norm $\|\nabla u\|_{\ell^2L^4_{t,x}}$.
